errors.message: ERR Error registering functions: ERR description argument given to redis.register_function must be a string
errors.explain: In the table form of `redis.register_function`, the `description` field isn't a string. Set it to a short text that describes the function, or leave it out.

errors.message: ERR Error registering functions: ERR first argument to redis.register_function must be a string
errors.explain: You called `redis.register_function` with two arguments, but the first one isn't a string. Pass the function name first and the callback second, as in `redis.register_function('my_func', my_callback)`.

errors.message: ERR Error registering functions: ERR flags argument to redis.register_function must be a table representing function flags
errors.explain: In the table form of `redis.register_function`, the `flags` field isn't a table. Pass the flags as a Lua table of strings, such as `flags = { 'no-writes' }`, even when there's only one.

errors.message: ERR Error registering functions: ERR Function already exists in the library
errors.explain: Your library code calls `redis.register_function` twice with the same function name. Give each function in the library a unique name.

errors.message: ERR Error registering functions: ERR FUNCTION LOAD timeout
errors.explain: Your library's top-level code ran for more than 500 milliseconds during `FUNCTION LOAD`, so Redis stopped it. That code should only register functions; move any long-running work into the function callbacks, and check for an endless loop.

errors.message: ERR Error registering functions: ERR function_name argument given to redis.register_function must be a string
errors.explain: In the table form of `redis.register_function`, the `function_name` field isn't a string. Set it to the name that you'll pass to `FCALL`.

errors.message: ERR Error registering functions: ERR Library names can only contain letters, numbers, or underscores(_) and must be at least one character long
errors.explain: A function name passed to `redis.register_function` is empty or has characters other than letters, digits, and underscores, even though the message says library names. Rename the function using only those characters, such as `my_func`.

errors.message: ERR Error registering functions: ERR named argument key given to redis.register_function is not a string
errors.explain: The table you passed to `redis.register_function` has a key that isn't a string, such as `true` or a table. Use only the named fields `function_name`, `callback`, `flags`, and `description`.

errors.message: ERR Error registering functions: ERR redis.register_function must get a callback argument
errors.explain: The table you passed to `redis.register_function` has no `callback` field. Add `callback` and set it to the Lua function that `FCALL` should run.

errors.message: ERR Error registering functions: ERR redis.register_function must get a function name argument
errors.explain: The table you passed to `redis.register_function` has no `function_name` field. Add `function_name` and set it to the name that you'll pass to `FCALL`.

errors.message: ERR Error registering functions: ERR second argument to redis.register_function must be a function
errors.explain: You called `redis.register_function` with two arguments, but the second one isn't a function. Pass the function itself, not its name as a string or the result of calling it.

errors.message: ERR Error registering functions: ERR unknown argument given to redis.register_function
errors.explain: The table you passed to `redis.register_function` has a field other than `function_name`, `callback`, `flags`, and `description`, or an entry without a name. Check the field names for typos.

errors.message: ERR Error registering functions: ERR unknown flag given
errors.explain: The `flags` table you passed to `redis.register_function` has an entry that isn't a known flag name. Valid flags are `no-writes`, `allow-oom`, `allow-stale`, `no-cluster`, and `allow-cross-slot-keys`.

errors.message: ERR Error registering functions: ERR user_function:<line>: Script attempted to access nonexistent global variable '<name>'
errors.example: ERR Error registering functions: ERR user_function:2: Script attempted to access nonexistent global variable 'foo'
errors.explain: While `FUNCTION LOAD` ran your library's top-level code, it read a global that doesn't exist at load time, named in the message. Only `redis.register_function`, `redis.log`, and the version fields exist then, so move other calls into the function callbacks and use `local` for your variables.

errors.message: ERR Error registering functions: ERR wrong number of arguments to redis.register_function
errors.explain: You called `redis.register_function` with no arguments or more than two. Pass either the function name and the callback, or a single table of named arguments.

errors.message: ERR Error running script <script>, <error>
errors.explain: A script or function failed in a way that Redis couldn't report as usual, which can happen when Lua runs out of memory or its error handling fails. The end of the message shows the Lua error; check the script for runaway memory use.

errors.message: ERR error saving the cluster node config: <reason>
errors.explain: `CLUSTER SAVECONFIG` couldn't write the cluster configuration file, set by `cluster-config-file`, for the operating system reason at the end of the message. Check that the file and its directory are writable and that the disk isn't full.

errors.message: ERR Error trying to load the AOF files, check server logs.
ERR Error trying to load the RDB dump, check server logs.
ERR Error unloading module: no such module with that name
errors.explain: No loaded module has the name you passed to `MODULE UNLOAD`, which takes the module's name, not its file path. Run `MODULE LIST` to see the names, such as `search` or `ReJSON`.

errors.message: ERR Error unloading module: operation not possible.
errors.explain: The module refused to be unloaded: its unload callback returned an error, and the Redis log says that the unload was canceled. Check the module's documentation for what it needs before it can be unloaded.

errors.message: ERR Error unloading module: the module can't be unloaded
errors.explain: The module is built into the Redis server instead of loaded from a file, so it can't be unloaded. In Redis 8, this applies to the vector sets module, `vectorset`.

errors.message: ERR Error unloading module: the module exports APIs used by other modules. Please unload them first and try again
errors.explain: Other loaded modules depend on functions that this module exports to them. Unload those modules first, then unload this one.

errors.message: ERR Error unloading module: the module exports one or more module-side data types, can't unload
errors.explain: The module defines its own data types, so Redis can't unload it while it runs, because keys of those types may exist. This applies to Search, JSON, probabilistic, and time series; to remove one, take it out of the server's `loadmodule` configuration and restart Redis.

errors.message: ERR Error unloading module: the module has blocked clients. Please wait for them to be unblocked and try again
errors.explain: Some clients are still blocked on commands of this module, so Redis can't unload it yet. Wait for those commands to finish or time out, then try again.

errors.message: ERR Error unloading module: the module holds timer that is not fired. Please stop the timer or wait until it fires.
errors.explain: The module has a timer that hasn't fired yet, so Redis can't unload it. Wait for the timer to fire, or stop it with the module's own commands if it has any, then try again.

errors.message: ERR Errors trying to SHUTDOWN. Check logs.
errors.explain: Your `SHUTDOWN` was waiting for replicas to catch up, but the shutdown was canceled. Either it failed, for example because the final save failed, or another client ran `SHUTDOWN ABORT`. The server is still running, and its log has the reason.

errors.message: ERR exactly one of BYRADIUS and BYBOX can be specified for <command>
errors.explain: You called `GEOSEARCH` or `GEOSEARCHSTORE` without a search shape. Add either `BYRADIUS` with a radius and unit, or `BYBOX` with a width, height, and unit; passing both is a syntax error.

errors.message: ERR exactly one of FROMMEMBER or FROMLONLAT can be specified for <command>
errors.explain: You called `GEOSEARCH` or `GEOSEARCHSTORE` without a center point. Add either `FROMMEMBER` with a member of the set, or `FROMLONLAT` with a longitude and latitude; passing both is a syntax error.

errors.message: ERR EXEC without MULTI
errors.explain: You sent `EXEC`, but this connection has no open transaction. This often happens when a connection pool sends `MULTI` and `EXEC` on different connections, or after the transaction has already ended; send `MULTI`, the commands, and `EXEC` on one connection.

errors.message: ERR Failed creating the library
errors.explain: Redis couldn't create a library from the `FUNCTION RESTORE` payload. Load the library from its source code with `FUNCTION LOAD`, which reports the exact problem.

errors.message: ERR Failed loading library payload
errors.explain: Redis couldn't read a library's code from the `FUNCTION RESTORE` payload, so the payload is truncated or malformed. Pass the exact, unmodified output of `FUNCTION DUMP`.

errors.message: ERR failed loading the given functions payload
errors.explain: Redis couldn't load the libraries in the payload you passed to `FUNCTION RESTORE`. Pass the exact, unmodified output of `FUNCTION DUMP`, or load the libraries from their source code with `FUNCTION LOAD`.

errors.message: ERR Failed to create idempotency hash
errors.explain: `XADD` with `IDMPAUTO` couldn't compute the idempotent ID from the entry's fields and values, which can happen when the server can't allocate memory for it. Retry the command, and check the server's memory if it keeps happening.

errors.message: ERR Failed to handle master task: <task>
errors.explain: A replica couldn't apply the details of an atomic slot migration that its primary sent. This is internal to the migration. Check the replica's log, and check that the replica is in sync with its primary.

errors.message: ERR failed to restart the server. Check server logs.
ERR Failed to save config file. Check server logs.
errors.explain: Sentinel made your change but couldn't rewrite its configuration file, so the change is lost when Sentinel restarts. Check the Sentinel log for the reason, which is often a configuration file or directory that the Sentinel user can't write to.

errors.message: ERR Failed to set ASM fail point
ERR Failed to set ASM trim method
ERR FAILOVER already in progress.
errors.explain: A failover started by an earlier `FAILOVER` is still running. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it with `FAILOVER ABORT` before you start a new one.

errors.message: ERR FAILOVER is not valid when server is a replica.
errors.explain: You sent `FAILOVER` to a replica, but it only works on a primary, which hands its role to one of its replicas. Send it to the current primary instead.

errors.message: ERR FAILOVER not allowed in cluster mode. Use CLUSTER FAILOVER command instead.
errors.explain: `FAILOVER` works only outside cluster mode. In a cluster, send `CLUSTER FAILOVER` to the replica that should become the primary.

errors.message: ERR FAILOVER requires connected replicas.
errors.explain: You sent `FAILOVER` to a primary that has no connected replicas, so there's nothing to promote. Connect at least one replica, and check `INFO replication` before you retry.

errors.message: ERR FAILOVER target HOST and PORT is not a replica.
errors.explain: The host and port after `TO` don't match any replica connected to this primary. Use the address and port that `INFO replication` lists for the replica.

errors.message: ERR FAILOVER target replica is not online.
errors.explain: The replica you named with `TO` is connected but hasn't finished its initial sync, so it can't take over yet. Wait until `INFO replication` shows it as `online`, then retry.

errors.message: ERR FAILOVER timeout must be greater than 0
errors.explain: The value after `TIMEOUT` in `FAILOVER` is 0 or negative. Pass a positive number of milliseconds, or leave `TIMEOUT` out to wait with no time limit.

errors.message: ERR FAILOVER with force option requires both a timeout and target HOST and IP.
errors.explain: You passed `FORCE` to `FAILOVER` without both `TIMEOUT` and `TO` followed by a host and port. Add `TO` with the replica's host and port, and `TIMEOUT` in milliseconds, so Redis knows which replica to force and when.

errors.message: ERR FIELDS keyword specified multiple times
errors.explain: You used the `FIELDS` keyword more than once in the same command. Put all the fields in one `FIELDS` block, with the number of fields first.

errors.message: ERR FIELDS requires at least numfields and one field argument
errors.explain: `FIELDS` is too close to the end of the command to be followed by a field count and at least one field. Put `FIELDS`, the number of fields, and the field names last, for example `HEXPIRE key 60 NX FIELDS 1 field`.

errors.message: ERR Filtered replica requires EOF capability
ERR First argument must be a number (log level). script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
errors.explain: Your script called `redis.log()` with a first argument that isn't a number. Pass the log level first and then the message, for example `redis.log(redis.LOG_WARNING, 'text')`.

errors.message: ERR Fork() failed: can't run EVAL in debugging mode: <reason>
errors.explain: You ran `EVAL` after `SCRIPT DEBUG YES`, which debugs in a forked copy of the server, and the fork failed for the reason shown, usually low memory. Free memory, or use `SCRIPT DEBUG SYNC`, which doesn't fork but blocks the server while you debug.

errors.message: ERR Function <function> already exists
errors.example: ERR Function g already exists
errors.explain: A function in the library you're loading has the same name as a function in another loaded library, and function names must be unique across all libraries. Rename the function, or remove the other library with `FUNCTION DELETE`; with `FUNCTION RESTORE`, the `FLUSH` policy replaces all libraries.

errors.message: ERR Function code is missing
errors.explain: You ran `FUNCTION LOAD` without the library code. Pass the code as the last argument, after the optional `REPLACE`.

errors.message: ERR FUNCTION FLUSH only supports SYNC|ASYNC option
errors.explain: You passed `FUNCTION FLUSH` an argument other than `SYNC` or `ASYNC`. Run `FUNCTION FLUSH SYNC` or `FUNCTION FLUSH ASYNC`, or no option at all to let the `lazyfree-lazy-user-flush` setting choose.

errors.message: ERR Function not found
errors.explain: No loaded library has a function with the name you passed to `FCALL` or `FCALL_RO`. Check the loaded functions with `FUNCTION LIST`, and load the library with `FUNCTION LOAD` if it's missing, for example on a new server or after `FUNCTION FLUSH`.

errors.message: ERR GEOSEARCHSTORE is not compatible with WITHDIST, WITHHASH and WITHCOORD options
errors.explain: You passed `WITHDIST`, `WITHHASH`, or `WITHCOORD` to `GEOSEARCHSTORE`, which stores its results instead of returning them. Remove those options; to store distances, use `STOREDIST`, or run `GEOSEARCH` to get the details back.

errors.message: ERR GET option of SORT denied due to insufficient ACL permissions.
errors.explain: You ran `SORT` with `GET`, which needs read access to every key, even for `GET #`, but your user's access control list (ACL) rules don't allow that. Give the user read access to all keys, such as `%R~*` or `~*`, or leave out `GET`.

errors.message: ERR GET option of SORT denied in Cluster mode when keys formed by the pattern may be in different slots.
errors.explain: You ran `SORT` with a `GET` pattern in a cluster, and the keys it builds may be in another hash slot than the sorted key. Start the pattern with the key's hash tag, or read the values separately. `GET #` is always allowed.

errors.message: ERR given type is not a function
errors.explain: The payload you passed to `FUNCTION RESTORE` isn't a functions payload, usually because it's the output of `DUMP` for a key. Make the payload with `FUNCTION DUMP`, or restore a key's payload with `RESTORE`.

errors.message: ERR GT and LT options at the same time are not compatible
errors.explain: You passed both `GT` and `LT` to `EXPIRE`, `PEXPIRE`, `EXPIREAT`, or `PEXPIREAT`, but a new expiry can't be both greater and less than the current one. Keep only one of them.

errors.message: ERR GT, LT, and/or NX options at the same time are not compatible
errors.explain: You passed `ZADD` more than one of `GT`, `LT` and `NX`, which conflict with each other. Use at most one of them; `XX` can be combined with `GT` or `LT`.

errors.message: ERR hash value is not a float
errors.explain: `HINCRBYFLOAT` can't add to the field, because its current value isn't a number. Set the field to a numeric value first, or increment a different field.

errors.message: ERR hash value is not an integer
errors.explain: `HINCRBY` can't add to the field, because its current value isn't an integer, for example `1.5` or text. Use `HINCRBYFLOAT` for decimal values, or set the field to an integer first.

errors.message: ERR height or width cannot be negative
errors.explain: The width or height after `BYBOX` in `GEOSEARCH` or `GEOSEARCHSTORE` is negative. Pass sizes of 0 or more, followed by the unit.

errors.message: ERR HLL encoding is not sparse
ERR hotkey tracking session already in progress
errors.explain: A hotkey tracking session is already running, and only one can run at a time. Run `HOTKEYS STOP` first, then start the new session.

errors.message: ERR hotkey tracking session in progress, stop tracking first
errors.explain: You ran `HOTKEYS RESET` while a tracking session is still running. Run `HOTKEYS STOP` first, then `HOTKEYS RESET` to free the results.

errors.message: ERR HOTKEYS subcommand required
errors.explain: You ran `HOTKEYS` without a subcommand. Add one of `START`, `STOP`, `GET`, `RESET`, or `HELP`.

errors.message: ERR I can only replicate a master, not a replica.
errors.explain: `CLUSTER REPLICATE` takes the ID of a primary, and you passed the ID of a replica. Use the ID of that replica's primary, as shown by `CLUSTER NODES`.

errors.message: ERR I don't know about node <node_id>
errors.explain: `CLUSTER SETSLOT` with `MIGRATING` or `IMPORTING` names a node ID that this node doesn't know. Check the ID with `CLUSTER NODES` on this node.

errors.message: ERR I tried hard but I can't forget myself...
errors.explain: You passed this node's own ID to `CLUSTER FORGET`. To remove this node from the cluster, run the command on each of the other nodes.

errors.message: ERR I'm a replica but my master is unknown to me
errors.explain: This replica doesn't know which node is its primary, so it can't fail over. Check its role with `CLUSTER NODES`, and set its primary with `CLUSTER REPLICATE` if needed.

errors.message: ERR I'm already the owner of hash slot <slot>
errors.explain: `CLUSTER SETSLOT` with `IMPORTING` was sent to the node that already serves the slot. Send it to the node that should receive the slot.

errors.message: ERR I'm not the owner of hash slot <slot>
errors.explain: `CLUSTER SETSLOT` with `MIGRATING` must go to the node that serves the slot, and this node doesn't. Send it to the slot's current owner, shown by `CLUSTER SHARDS` or `CLUSTER NODES`.

errors.message: ERR idempotent ID must be non-empty
errors.explain: `XIDMPRECORD`, an internal command, got an empty idempotent ID, the argument after the producer ID. Pass a non-empty string.

errors.message: ERR IDMP-DURATION must be between 1 and 86400 seconds
errors.explain: You passed `XCFGSET` an `IDMP-DURATION` outside the range of 1 to 86400 seconds (one day). Pass how long the stream remembers each idempotent ID, within that range.

errors.message: ERR IDMP-DURATION specified multiple times
errors.explain: You passed `IDMP-DURATION` more than once in one `XCFGSET` command. Pass it once.

errors.message: ERR IDMP-MAXSIZE must be between 1 and 10000 entries
errors.explain: You passed `XCFGSET` an `IDMP-MAXSIZE` outside the range of 1 to 10000. Pass how many idempotent IDs the stream keeps for each producer, within that range.

errors.message: ERR IDMP-MAXSIZE specified multiple times
errors.explain: You passed `IDMP-MAXSIZE` more than once in one `XCFGSET` command. Pass it once.

errors.message: ERR IDS option is required
errors.explain: You ran `XACKDEL` or `XDELEX` without the `IDS` block. Add `IDS`, the number of entry IDs, and the IDs themselves.

errors.message: ERR If you want both the length and indexes, please just use IDX.
errors.explain: You passed both `LEN` and `IDX` to `LCS`. Use only `IDX`, whose reply already includes the length.

errors.message: ERR IID already exists for this producer with a different stream ID
errors.explain: `XIDMPRECORD`, an internal command, tried to link an idempotent ID to an entry, but that producer already uses the ID for a different entry. One idempotent ID can point to only one entry for each producer; use a different ID.

errors.message: ERR INCR option supports a single increment-element pair
errors.explain: You passed `ZADD` the `INCR` option with more than one score and member pair. With `INCR`, pass exactly one increment and one member, or use `ZINCRBY`.

errors.message: ERR Increment is not a valid float
errors.explain: The value after `BYFLOAT` in `INCREX` isn't a number. Pass a decimal number, such as `1.5`.

errors.message: ERR Increment is not an integer or out of range
errors.explain: The value after `BYINT` in `INCREX` isn't an integer between -9223372036854775808 and 9223372036854775807. Pass a whole number, or use `BYFLOAT` for decimal increments.

errors.message: ERR increment or decrement would overflow
errors.explain: The result would be outside the range of a signed 64-bit integer, -9223372036854775808 to 9223372036854775807. Use a smaller increment, or reset the value first.

errors.message: ERR increment would produce NaN or Infinity
errors.explain: The result of `INCRBYFLOAT` or `HINCRBYFLOAT` would be infinite or not a number (NaN), for example because the increment is `inf` or the values are extremely large. Use finite values within the normal range.

errors.message: ERR index out of range
errors.explain: `LSET` got an index beyond the ends of the list. Use an index from 0 to the length minus 1, or a negative index from -1 down to minus the length; `LLEN` returns the length.

errors.message: ERR insert index overflow
errors.explain: `ARINSERT` would write past the last valid array index, 18446744073709551614, because its insert position, which `ARSEEK` and earlier inserts move forward, is too close to it. Move the insert position back with `ARSEEK`, or use a new key.

errors.message: ERR Insufficient memory, failed allocating transient memory for LCS
errors.explain: `LCS` couldn't allocate the working table it needs, which takes about 4 bytes times the product of the two string lengths. Compare shorter strings, or free memory on the server.

errors.message: ERR Insufficient memory, failed allocating transient memory, COUNT too high.
errors.explain: The `COUNT` you passed to `XAUTOCLAIM` is so large that Redis couldn't allocate the memory it reserves for it in advance. Use a smaller count, such as the default of 100, and call `XAUTOCLAIM` again with the cursor it returns.

errors.message: ERR Insufficient memory, failed allocating transient memory, too many args.
errors.explain: Redis couldn't allocate memory to hold the list of input keys for the command. This only happens with an enormous number of keys or a server that's out of memory; pass fewer keys in each call.

errors.message: ERR Insufficient memory, transient memory for LCS exceeds proto-max-bulk-len
errors.explain: `LCS` needs a working table of about 4 bytes times the product of the two string lengths, and that's more than `proto-max-bulk-len`, 512 MB by default, which two strings of about 11,600 bytes each already exceed. Compare shorter strings.

errors.message: ERR Internal secret is missing
ERR Invalid argument '<argument>' for SENTINEL DEBUG '<option>'
ERR Invalid argument '<argument>' for SENTINEL SET '<option>'
errors.explain: You ran `SENTINEL SET` with a value that the option named in the message doesn't accept. `quorum`, `down-after-milliseconds`, `failover-timeout` and `parallel-syncs` need an integer of 1 or more, `master-reboot-down-after-period` needs 0 or more, and `rename-command` names can't be empty.

errors.message: ERR Invalid argument '<option>' to SENTINEL CONFIG SET
errors.explain: You ran `SENTINEL CONFIG SET` with an option it doesn't support. You can set `announce-ip`, `announce-port`, `announce-hostnames`, `resolve-hostnames`, `sentinel-user`, `sentinel-pass` and `loglevel`.

errors.message: ERR Invalid arguments specified for command
errors.explain: `COMMAND GETKEYS` couldn't find the keys in the command you passed, because its arguments don't add up, for example a key count larger than the number of keys given. Pass the full command exactly as you would run it.

errors.message: ERR invalid array index
errors.explain: An array index you passed isn't a whole number from 0 to 18446744073709551614; negative numbers and text aren't accepted. Pass a valid index. `ARGREP` also accepts `-` and `+` for the first and last index.

errors.message: ERR Invalid base port specified: <port>
errors.explain: The port you passed to `CLUSTER MEET` isn't a whole number. Pass the node's client port, such as `6379`.

errors.message: ERR Invalid bitfield type. Use something like i16 u8. Note that u64 is not supported but i64 is.
errors.explain: A bitfield type is `i` for signed or `u` for unsigned, followed by a width in bits: `i1` to `i64`, or `u1` to `u63`. Unsigned 64-bit fields aren't supported, so use `i64` instead.

errors.message: ERR Invalid bus port specified: <bus_port>
errors.explain: The cluster bus port you passed to `CLUSTER MEET` isn't a whole number. Pass the node's bus port, or leave it out to use the client port plus 10000.

errors.message: ERR Invalid client ID
errors.explain: One of the values after `CLIENT LIST ID` isn't an integer. Pass the numeric client IDs that `CLIENT ID` or `CLIENT LIST` shows.

errors.message: ERR Invalid CLUSTER SETSLOT action or number of arguments. Try CLUSTER HELP
errors.explain: `CLUSTER SETSLOT` takes a slot and then `IMPORTING`, `MIGRATING`, or `NODE` followed by a node ID, or `STABLE` alone. Check the action name and the number of arguments.

errors.message: ERR Invalid command passed to redis.acl_check_cmd() script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
errors.explain: Your script called `redis.acl_check_cmd()` with a first argument that isn't a command or subcommand this server knows. Pass the command name first, followed by its arguments, for example `redis.acl_check_cmd('get', 'key')`.

errors.message: ERR Invalid command specified
errors.explain: You passed `COMMAND GETKEYS` or `COMMAND GETKEYSANDFLAGS` a command or subcommand that this server doesn't know. Check the spelling, and that the module that adds the command is loaded.

errors.message: ERR Invalid condition. Use IFEQ, IFNE, IFDEQ, or IFDNE
errors.explain: The condition you passed to `DELEX` isn't one it knows. Use `IFEQ` or `IFNE` with a value, or `IFDEQ` or `IFDNE` with a digest of the value.

errors.message: ERR Invalid config epoch specified: <epoch>
errors.explain: `CLUSTER SET-CONFIG-EPOCH` takes a config epoch of 0 or more, and you passed a negative number. While you create a cluster, give each node a different epoch.

errors.message: ERR invalid COUNT
errors.explain: The count you passed isn't valid. For `VSIM`, the value after `COUNT` must be a whole number greater than 0. For `ARLASTITEMS`, the count must be an integer, and 0 or less returns an empty array.

errors.message: ERR invalid cursor
errors.explain: The cursor you passed to `SCAN`, `HSCAN`, `SSCAN`, or `ZSCAN` isn't a whole number of 0 or more. Start with `0`, then pass back the exact cursor that the previous call returned.

errors.message: ERR invalid end ID for the interval
errors.explain: You passed an exclusive end ID, marked with `(`, that has no ID before it, such as `(0-0`. Use a larger end ID, or remove the `(`.

errors.message: ERR Invalid engine in script shebang
errors.explain: Your script starts with `#!`, but Redis couldn't parse that first line, usually because it has an unbalanced quote. Make the first line `#!lua`, optionally followed by `flags=` and a comma-separated list of flags, then a newline.

errors.message: ERR invalid expire time in '<command>' command
errors.example: ERR invalid expire time in 'set' command
errors.explain: The expiry time is out of range for the command named in the message. For `SET`, `SETEX`, `GETEX`, and similar commands it must be greater than 0; for `EXPIRE`, `HEXPIRE`, and their variants, it's so large that it would overflow once converted to an absolute time in milliseconds.

errors.message: ERR invalid expire time, must be >= 0
errors.explain: The expiration time you passed is negative. Pass 0 or more: a number of seconds or milliseconds for relative times, or a Unix timestamp for `EXAT`, `PXAT`, `HEXPIREAT` and `HPEXPIREAT`.

errors.message: ERR invalid first DB index
errors.explain: The first database number in `SWAPDB` isn't a whole number. Pass two database numbers, such as `SWAPDB 0 1`.

errors.message: ERR Invalid FREQ value, must be >= 0 and <= 255
errors.explain: The value after `FREQ` in `RESTORE` is out of range. Pass a least frequently used (LFU) counter from 0 to 255.

errors.message: ERR Invalid IDLE option argument for XCLAIM
errors.explain: The value after `IDLE` in `XCLAIM` isn't an integer. Pass the idle time to set, in milliseconds.

errors.message: ERR Invalid IDLETIME value, must be >= 0
errors.explain: The value after `IDLETIME` in `RESTORE` is negative. Pass the idle time in seconds, as 0 or more.

errors.message: ERR Invalid IP address or hostname specified
errors.explain: You ran `SENTINEL MONITOR` with an address that isn't a valid Internet Protocol (IP) address, or a host name that Sentinel can't resolve. Sentinel accepts host names only when `resolve-hostnames` is `yes`; otherwise, pass an IP address.

errors.message: ERR Invalid library metadata
errors.explain: The first line of your library starts with `#!` but can't be read, because no newline follows it or it has an unbalanced quote. Put `#!lua name=mylib` alone on the first line, followed by a newline and then the code.

errors.message: ERR Invalid log level. script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
errors.explain: Your script called `redis.log()` with a log level outside the valid range of 0 to 3. Use one of the constants `redis.LOG_DEBUG`, `redis.LOG_VERBOSE`, `redis.LOG_NOTICE` or `redis.LOG_WARNING`.

errors.message: ERR invalid longitude,latitude pair <longitude>,<latitude>
errors.example: ERR invalid longitude,latitude pair 200.000000,100.000000
errors.explain: The coordinates in the message are out of range: longitude must be between -180 and 180, and latitude between -85.05112878 and 85.05112878. Redis takes longitude first, so check that you didn't swap the two.

errors.message: ERR Invalid master port
errors.explain: The port you passed to `REPLICAOF` isn't an integer from 0 to 65535. Pass the port the primary listens on, usually `6379`, or use `REPLICAOF NO ONE` to stop replicating.

errors.message: ERR Invalid metadata value given: <value>
errors.explain: The shebang line of your library has an option other than `name=`, shown in the message. Libraries accept only `name=`; set flags such as `no-writes` on each function in `redis.register_function` instead.

errors.message: ERR Invalid metadata value, name argument was given multiple times
errors.explain: The shebang line of your library has more than one `name=` option. Keep a single `name=` with the library's name.

errors.message: ERR Invalid min-idle-time argument for XAUTOCLAIM
errors.explain: The minimum idle time you passed to `XAUTOCLAIM`, the argument after the consumer name, isn't an integer. Pass it in milliseconds, for example 60000 for one minute.

errors.message: ERR Invalid min-idle-time argument for XCLAIM
errors.explain: The minimum idle time you passed to `XCLAIM`, the argument after the consumer name, isn't an integer. Pass it in milliseconds, for example 60000 for one minute.

errors.message: ERR Invalid node address specified: <ip>:<port>
errors.explain: `CLUSTER MEET` needs a numeric address, not a hostname, and ports from 1 to 65535, and the address or a port isn't valid. If you have a hostname, resolve it to its address first.

errors.message: ERR Invalid node id length <length>
errors.explain: A `CLUSTER SYNCSLOTS CONF` message carried a node ID that isn't 40 characters long. Nodes send this message to each other during an atomic slot migration, so check that all nodes run the same Redis version.

errors.message: ERR Invalid number of arguments specified for command
errors.explain: You passed `COMMAND GETKEYS` or `COMMAND GETKEYSANDFLAGS` a command with the wrong number of arguments for it, such as `SET` with no key. Pass the full command with all of its arguments.

errors.message: ERR invalid number of fields
errors.explain: The number after `FIELDS` in `HGETEX` or `HSETEX` is 0, negative, or not an integer. Pass the number of fields that follow it, from 1 to 2147483647.

errors.message: ERR invalid number of ranges
errors.explain: The number after `RANGES` in `TRIMSLOTS` must be from 1 to 16384, and the command must then list exactly that many pairs of start and end slots. Check the count against the pairs you passed.

errors.message: ERR invalid number of slot ranges: <count>
errors.explain: You passed 16384 or more slot ranges, which is more than the number of slots in a cluster. Merge neighboring slots into fewer ranges, for example one range `0 999` instead of a range for each slot.

errors.message: ERR invalid numkeys value
errors.explain: The first argument of `MSETEX`, the number of keys, is 0, negative, or not an integer. Pass the number of key and value pairs that follow it, which must be at least 1.

errors.message: ERR Invalid or out of range slot
errors.explain: A hash slot number in the command isn't a whole number from 0 to 16383. Check the slot arguments. `CLUSTER KEYSLOT` shows the slot of a key.

errors.message: ERR Invalid OVERFLOW type specified
errors.explain: The value after `OVERFLOW` in `BITFIELD` isn't valid. Use `WRAP`, `SAT`, or `FAIL`.

errors.message: ERR Invalid port
errors.explain: You ran `SENTINEL MONITOR` with a port that isn't an integer. Pass the port that the primary listens on as a number, such as 6379.

errors.message: ERR Invalid port number.
errors.explain: You ran `SENTINEL MONITOR` with a port outside the range 0 to 65535. Pass the port that the primary listens on, such as 6379.

errors.message: ERR Invalid quorum
errors.explain: You ran `SENTINEL MONITOR` with a quorum that isn't an integer. The quorum is the number of Sentinels that must agree that the primary is down; pass it as a whole number of 1 or more.

errors.message: ERR invalid regular expression: <reason>
errors.explain: An `RE` pattern that you passed to `ARGREP` isn't a valid extended regular expression; the end of the message says what's wrong, such as a missing parenthesis. Fix the pattern, and escape characters that have a special meaning.

errors.message: ERR Invalid replication flags. Use REPL_AOF, REPL_REPLICA, REPL_ALL or REPL_NONE. script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
errors.explain: Your script passed `redis.set_repl()` a number that isn't a valid combination of replication flags. Pass one of the constants `redis.REPL_NONE`, `redis.REPL_AOF`, `redis.REPL_REPLICA` or `redis.REPL_ALL`.

errors.message: ERR Invalid RETRYCOUNT option argument for XCLAIM
errors.explain: The value after `RETRYCOUNT` in `XCLAIM` isn't an integer. Pass the delivery count to set, as a whole number.

errors.message: ERR Invalid RETRYCOUNT value, must be >= 0
errors.explain: You passed `XNACK` a negative `RETRYCOUNT`. Pass 0 or more to set the delivery count of the entries you release.

errors.message: ERR Invalid script shebang
errors.explain: Your script starts with `#!` but contains no newline, so the shebang line never ends. Put the shebang, such as `#!lua`, alone on the first line, and the Lua code on the lines after it.

errors.message: ERR invalid second DB index
errors.explain: The second database number in `SWAPDB` isn't a whole number. Pass two database numbers, such as `SWAPDB 0 1`.

errors.message: ERR invalid size
errors.explain: You ran `ARRING` with a ring size that isn't an integer. Pass the number of slots in the ring buffer as a whole number of 1 or more.

errors.message: ERR Invalid slot
errors.explain: `CLUSTER COUNTKEYSINSLOT` takes a hash slot from 0 to 16383, and you passed a number outside that range.

errors.message: ERR Invalid slot info: <slot_info>
errors.explain: A `CLUSTER SYNCSLOTS CONF` message carried slot details that aren't three non-negative numbers, slot, key count, and expiry count, separated by colons. Nodes send this message to each other during an atomic slot migration, so check that all nodes run the same Redis version.

errors.message: ERR Invalid slot or number of keys
errors.explain: `CLUSTER GETKEYSINSLOT` needs a hash slot from 0 to 16383 and a count of 0 or more, and one of them is out of range.

errors.message: ERR invalid start ID for the interval
errors.explain: You passed an exclusive start ID, marked with `(`, that has no ID after it, because it's the largest possible ID. Use a smaller start ID, or remove the `(`.

errors.message: ERR Invalid stream ID specified as stream command argument
errors.explain: A stream entry ID you passed isn't valid. Write it as milliseconds and a sequence number joined by a dash, such as `1526919030474-55`, or as the milliseconds alone. `-` and `+` work only where the command allows them.

errors.message: ERR Invalid task id
errors.explain: During an atomic slot migration, a node opened its data connection with a task ID that isn't 40 characters long. This is internal to the migration. Check `CLUSTER MIGRATION STATUS` on the importing node, and import again if the task failed.

errors.message: ERR Invalid TIME option argument for XCLAIM
errors.explain: The value after `TIME` in `XCLAIM` isn't an integer. Pass a Unix time in milliseconds.

errors.message: ERR Invalid TTL value, must be >= 0
errors.explain: The time to live (TTL) you passed to `RESTORE` is negative. Pass the TTL in milliseconds, 0 for no expiry, or a Unix time in milliseconds together with `ABSTTL`.

errors.message: ERR Invalid value '<value>' to SENTINEL CONFIG SET '<option>'
errors.explain: You ran `SENTINEL CONFIG SET` with a value that the option named in the message doesn't accept. `resolve-hostnames` and `announce-hostnames` take `yes` or `no`, `announce-port` takes 0 to 65535, and `loglevel` takes `debug`, `verbose`, `notice`, `warning` or `nothing`.

errors.message: ERR Key should be of string type if conditions are specified
errors.explain: `DELEX` with a condition works only on string keys, and this key holds another type. Use `DEL` without a condition, or check the key's type with `TYPE`.

errors.message: ERR LBOUND can't be greater than UBOUND
errors.explain: You passed `INCREX` an `LBOUND` that's larger than its `UBOUND`. Make `LBOUND` the lowest and `UBOUND` the highest value that the result may take.

errors.message: ERR LBOUND is not a valid float
errors.explain: With `BYFLOAT`, `INCREX` reads `LBOUND` as a decimal number, and the value you passed isn't one. Pass a number such as `0` or `-1.5`.

errors.message: ERR LBOUND is not an integer or out of range
errors.explain: Without `BYFLOAT`, `INCREX` reads `LBOUND` as a 64-bit integer, and the value you passed isn't one. Pass a whole number, or add `BYFLOAT` to use decimal bounds.

errors.message: ERR Library '<library>' already exists
errors.example: ERR Library 'vlib2' already exists
errors.explain: A library with the name in the message is already loaded. To overwrite it, run `FUNCTION LOAD REPLACE`, or give the new library a different `name=` in its shebang line.

errors.message: ERR Library <library> already exists
errors.explain: The payload you passed to `FUNCTION RESTORE` has a library with the same name as one that's already loaded, and the default `APPEND` policy doesn't overwrite. Add `REPLACE` to overwrite libraries with the same name, or `FLUSH` to delete all existing libraries first.

errors.message: ERR library name argument was not given
errors.explain: You ended `FUNCTION LIST` with `LIBRARYNAME` but no pattern after it. Add a library name pattern, such as `LIBRARYNAME mylib*`.

errors.message: ERR Library name was not given
errors.explain: The shebang line of your library has no `name=` option. Start the code with a line such as `#!lua name=mylib`, followed by a newline.

errors.message: ERR Library names can only contain letters, numbers, or underscores(_) and must be at least one character long
errors.explain: The library name after `name=` is empty or has characters other than letters, digits, and underscores. Rename the library using only those characters, such as `name=my_lib`.

errors.message: ERR Library not found
errors.explain: No library with the name you passed to `FUNCTION DELETE` is loaded. Library names are case-sensitive, so check the exact name with `FUNCTION LIST`.

errors.message: ERR LIMIT can't be negative
errors.explain: You passed a `LIMIT` that's negative or not an integer. Pass the most elements to count, or 0 for no limit.

errors.message: ERR Limit has to lie in between 1 and 16384 (maximum number of slots).
errors.explain: The value after `LIMIT` in `CLUSTER SLOT-STATS` must be a whole number from 1 to 16384. Pass a value in that range, or leave out `LIMIT` to get all slots.

errors.message: ERR LIMIT must be positive
errors.explain: You passed `ARSCAN` or `ARGREP` a `LIMIT` of 0 or less. Pass a count of 1 or more, or leave out `LIMIT` to return every match in the range.

errors.message: ERR Lua redis lib command arguments must be strings or integers script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
errors.explain: Your script passed `redis.call()`, `redis.pcall()` or `redis.acl_check_cmd()` an argument that isn't a string or a number, such as a table, a boolean or `nil`. Convert each argument to a string or number, and pass the elements of a table as separate arguments.

errors.message: ERR luaRedisGenericCommand() recursive call detected. Are you doing funny stuff with Lua debug hooks?
errors.explain: The internal function behind `redis.call()` and `redis.pcall()`, named in the message, was called again while it was still running, which only Lua debug hooks can cause. Scripts can't set debug hooks in normal use, so look for modified Lua code or a debugging tool.

errors.message: ERR Main channel connection is not established
errors.explain: During an atomic slot migration, the importing node's main connection to this node closed before its data connection was set up, so this attempt failed. Check the network between the nodes. `CLUSTER MIGRATION STATUS` shows the task's state and retries.

errors.message: ERR Mandatory argument FIELDS is missing or not at the right position
errors.explain: The argument after the key isn't `FIELDS`. These commands need `FIELDS` right after the key, then the number of fields, then the field names, for example `HTTL key FIELDS 2 f1 f2`.

errors.message: ERR Master has not enabled replication compression
ERR Master is down or failed, please use CLUSTER FAILOVER FORCE
errors.explain: A normal `CLUSTER FAILOVER` needs the primary to be reachable, and this replica sees it as down or failed. Use `CLUSTER FAILOVER FORCE` to fail over without the primary, or `TAKEOVER` if most primaries are unreachable too.

errors.message: ERR Master name must not contain control characters
errors.explain: You ran `SENTINEL MONITOR` with a primary name that contains a control character, such as a newline or a tab. Choose a name made of printable characters only.

errors.message: ERR MATCH requires a value argument
errors.explain: You ran `AROP` with the `MATCH` operation but didn't pass exactly one value after it. Add the value to count, for example `AROP key 0 100 MATCH done`.

errors.message: ERR max number of clients + cluster connections reached
errors.explain: The server has reached its `maxclients` limit, which counts both client connections and connections to other cluster nodes. Redis sends this error to the new connection and closes it; close idle connections, or raise `maxclients`.

errors.message: ERR max number of clients reached
errors.explain: The server already has `maxclients` connections, 10000 by default, so it refused the new one and closed it. Close idle connections or fix connection leaks in your app, use a connection pool, or raise `maxclients`.

errors.message: ERR maxage is not an integer or out of range
errors.explain: The value after `CLIENT KILL MAXAGE` isn't an integer. Pass the minimum connection age in seconds, such as `MAXAGE 3600`.

errors.message: ERR maxage should be greater than 0
errors.explain: The value after `CLIENT KILL MAXAGE` is 0 or negative. Pass a positive number of seconds; Redis then kills the connections that are older than that.

errors.message: ERR MAXCOUNT must be a positive integer
errors.explain: You passed `XREAD` or `XREADGROUP` a `MAXCOUNT` of 0 or less. Pass the most entries to return across all the streams, which must be 1 or more.

errors.message: ERR MAXCOUNT must be greater than or equal to COUNT
errors.explain: `MAXCOUNT` limits the total number of entries across all the streams, so it can't be smaller than `COUNT`, the limit for each stream. Raise `MAXCOUNT` or lower `COUNT`.

errors.message: ERR MAXLEN can't be negative
errors.explain: You passed `LPOS` a `MAXLEN` that's negative or not an integer. Pass the number of elements to compare, or 0 to search the whole list.

errors.message: ERR maxmemory-clients is disabled.
ERR MAXSIZE must be a positive integer
errors.explain: You passed `XREAD` or `XREADGROUP` a `MAXSIZE` of 0 or less. Pass the largest reply size you want, in bytes, which must be 1 or more.

errors.message: ERR METRICS count does not match number of metric types provided
errors.explain: The count after `METRICS` in `HOTKEYS START` is larger than the number of metric names that follow it. Make the count match the names, as in `METRICS 1 CPU` or `METRICS 2 CPU NET`.

errors.message: ERR METRICS count must be > 0 and <= 2
errors.explain: The count after `METRICS` in `HOTKEYS START` isn't 1 or 2. Pass the number of metric names that follow it, which can be `CPU`, `NET`, or both.

errors.message: ERR METRICS CPU defined more than once!
errors.explain: The `METRICS` list in `HOTKEYS START` names `CPU` more than once. List each metric once, as in `METRICS 2 CPU NET`.

errors.message: ERR METRICS NET defined more than once!
errors.explain: The `METRICS` list in `HOTKEYS START` names `NET` more than once. List each metric once, as in `METRICS 2 CPU NET`.

errors.message: ERR METRICS no valid metrics passed. Supported: CPU|NET
errors.explain: None of the metric names after `METRICS` in `HOTKEYS START` is `CPU` or `NET`. Name at least one of them, as in `METRICS 1 CPU`.

errors.message: ERR METRICS parameter is required
errors.explain: `HOTKEYS START` must begin with `METRICS`, a count, and the metric names, before any other option. Start the command as `HOTKEYS START METRICS 1 CPU`, then add `COUNT`, `DURATION`, `SAMPLE`, or `SLOTS`.

errors.message: ERR min or max is not a float
errors.explain: A score bound you passed isn't a number. Use a number, a number with `(` in front to exclude it, or `-inf` and `+inf` for no limit.

errors.message: ERR min or max not valid string range item
errors.explain: A lexicographic bound you passed doesn't start with `[` (inclusive) or `(` (exclusive), and isn't `-` or `+`. Write bounds such as `[a` or `(b`, or use `-` and `+` for the lowest and highest values.

errors.message: ERR min-idle-time is not an integer or out of range
errors.explain: The value after `CLAIM` in `XREADGROUP` isn't an integer. Pass the minimum time, in milliseconds, that a pending entry must be idle before this consumer claims it.

errors.message: ERR min-idle-time must be a positive integer
errors.explain: The value after `CLAIM` in `XREADGROUP` is negative. Pass 0 or more milliseconds; 0 is accepted even though the message says positive.

errors.message: ERR Missing argument '<option>' value
errors.explain: You ran `SENTINEL CONFIG SET`, and the option named in the message, the last one in the command, has no value after it. Give every option a value, in name and value pairs.

errors.message: ERR missing expire time
errors.explain: You ended `HGETEX` or `HSETEX` with `EX`, `PX`, `EXAT` or `PXAT` and no time after it. Put the time right after the option, for example `EX 60`.

errors.message: ERR missing FIELDS argument
errors.explain: The command has no `FIELDS` block, so Redis doesn't know which fields to act on. Add `FIELDS`, the number of fields, and the field names, for example `HEXPIRE key 60 FIELDS 1 field`.

errors.message: ERR Missing GROUP option for XREADGROUP
errors.explain: You ran `XREADGROUP` without the `GROUP` option. Add `GROUP` followed by the group name and the consumer name before `STREAMS`, or use `XREAD` to read without a group.

errors.message: ERR Missing library metadata
errors.explain: The code you passed to `FUNCTION LOAD` doesn't start with a shebang line. Library code must begin with a line such as `#!lua name=mylib`, followed by a newline and then the Lua code.

errors.message: ERR missing ranges argument
errors.explain: The first argument of `TRIMSLOTS` must be the keyword `RANGES`, followed by the number of ranges and the ranges. Nodes normally send this command themselves after an atomic slot migration.

errors.message: ERR Missing rdb-filter-only values
ERR missing subcommand. Try <command> HELP.
errors.explain: You sent a command that only works with a subcommand, such as `CONFIG` or `CLIENT`, without one. Add the subcommand, and run the command followed by `HELP` to list them. For built-in commands, Redis usually reports a wrong number of arguments instead.

errors.message: ERR mode must be SILENT, FAIL, or FATAL
errors.explain: The argument after the group name in `XNACK` isn't a valid mode. Pass `SILENT`, `FAIL` or `FATAL`, which decide how the delivery count of the released entries changes.

errors.message: ERR Module blocking client on auth when not currently undergoing module authentication
errors.explain: A module tried to block a client for authentication while that client wasn't being authenticated by a module. This is a bug in the module; report it to its developers.

errors.message: ERR MODULE command not allowed. If the enable-module-command option is set to "local", you can run it from a local connection, otherwise you need to set this option in the configuration file, and then restart the server.
errors.explain: `MODULE` is turned off on this server, which is the default, so you can't load or unload modules at runtime. Set `enable-module-command` to `yes`, or to `local` for local connections only, in the configuration file and restart Redis, or load modules there with `loadmodule`.

errors.message: ERR module key failed to copy
errors.explain: `COPY` asked the module that owns the key's data type to duplicate the value, and the module reported a failure. Check the Redis log and the module's documentation, or re-create the value under the new key with the module's own commands.

errors.message: ERR MONITOR isn't allowed for DENY BLOCKING client
errors.explain: You ran `MONITOR` where Redis expects exactly one reply for each command, such as inside a `MULTI` transaction. Run `MONITOR` on its own, on a connection that you use only for monitoring.

errors.message: ERR MOVE is not allowed in cluster mode
errors.explain: In cluster mode there's only database 0, so `MOVE` can't move keys between databases. To move keys to another node, use `MIGRATE`.

errors.message: ERR MULTI calls can not be nested
errors.explain: You sent `MULTI` while a transaction was already open on this connection, and transactions can't be nested. The open transaction continues, so finish it with `EXEC` or `DISCARD` before you start another.

errors.message: ERR Multiple condition flags specified
errors.explain: You passed more than one of `NX`, `XX`, `GT` and `LT`, but these commands accept only one condition. Choose the one condition that decides whether the expiration is set.

errors.message: ERR Multiple filters of the same type are disallowed.
errors.explain: `CLUSTER SLOT-STATS` got `LIMIT` twice, or more than one of `ASC` and `DESC`. Pass each of these options at most once.

errors.message: ERR must be exactly 16 hexadecimal characters
errors.explain: The digest you passed to `IFDEQ` or `IFDNE` in `SET` or `DELEX` isn't 16 characters long. Pass the value's digest exactly as the `DIGEST` command returns it.

errors.message: ERR need numeric height
errors.explain: The height after `BYBOX` in `GEOSEARCH` or `GEOSEARCHSTORE` isn't a number. Pass the width and the height as numbers, then the unit, as in `BYBOX 10 5 km`.

errors.message: ERR need numeric radius
errors.explain: The radius in `GEORADIUS`, `GEORADIUSBYMEMBER`, or after `BYRADIUS` isn't a number. Pass the radius as a number followed by a separate unit, as in `BYRADIUS 5 km`, not `5km`.

errors.message: ERR need numeric width
errors.explain: The width after `BYBOX` in `GEOSEARCH` or `GEOSEARCHSTORE` isn't a number. Pass the width and the height as numbers, then the unit, as in `BYBOX 10 5 km`.

errors.message: ERR No backup in progress
errors.explain: `BACKUP ABORT` found no backup to cancel. Either none was started, or it was already sealed, aborted, or failed. Check the state with `BACKUP STATUS`, and remove a sealed or failed backup with `BACKUP CLEANUP`.

errors.message: ERR No backup ready to seal (must be in the incrementing state)
errors.explain: `BACKUP SEAL` works only after the backup's snapshot is complete, when `BACKUP STATUS` reports the state `incrementing`. Wait for the snapshot to finish, or run `BACKUP START` first if no backup is running.

errors.message: ERR No failover in progress.
errors.explain: You ran `FAILOVER ABORT`, but no failover is running, so there's nothing to cancel. It may have finished or timed out already.

errors.message: ERR No functions registered
errors.explain: Your library code ran without calling `redis.register_function`, so it defines no functions. Every library must register at least one function in its top-level code.

errors.message: ERR No ID yet
errors.explain: `CLUSTER MYID` found that this node has no node ID yet. Cluster nodes get an ID when they start, so this normally doesn't happen. Check that the server finished starting in cluster mode.

errors.message: ERR No samples available for event '<event>'
errors.explain: `LATENCY GRAPH` has no samples for the event in the message. Redis records an event only when it takes longer than `latency-monitor-threshold` milliseconds, and the default of 0 turns the monitor off; run `LATENCY LATEST` to see which events have samples.

errors.message: ERR No shard ID yet
errors.explain: `CLUSTER MYSHARDID` found that this node has no shard ID yet. Cluster nodes get one when they start, so this normally doesn't happen. Check that the server finished starting in cluster mode.

errors.message: ERR No shutdown in progress.
errors.explain: You ran `SHUTDOWN ABORT`, but no shutdown is in progress, so there's nothing to cancel. A shutdown can be aborted only while it's waiting, for example for replicas to catch up.

errors.message: ERR No slot migration task in progress
errors.explain: During an atomic slot migration, the importing node opened its data connection, but this node isn't running any migration, for example because it was canceled or timed out. Check `CLUSTER MIGRATION STATUS` on the importing node.

errors.message: ERR No such client
errors.explain: No connection matches the address you passed to `CLIENT KILL` in its old form, with only an address and port. Check the `addr` field in `CLIENT LIST`, or use the newer form, such as `CLIENT KILL ID 42`, which returns how many clients it killed.

errors.message: ERR no such fieldset
errors.explain: `HIMPORT SET` names a fieldset that this connection hasn't prepared. Fieldsets belong to the connection that ran `HIMPORT PREPARE`, and you lose them when you reconnect, run `RESET` or `HIMPORT DISCARD`, or a script ends, so prepare it again on the same connection.

errors.message: ERR no such key
errors.explain: The command needs a key that already exists, and the key you passed doesn't, for example the source key of `RENAME`, the list in `LSET`, or the stream in `XINFO` or `XSETID`. Check the key name and the database you're connected to.

errors.message: ERR No such master with that name
errors.explain: This Sentinel doesn't monitor a primary with the name you passed. Names are case-sensitive; run `SENTINEL MASTERS` to list the names it knows, or add the primary with `SENTINEL MONITOR`.

errors.message: ERR No such message in stream
errors.explain: `XIDMPRECORD` named an entry ID that isn't in the stream, for example because the entry was deleted or trimmed. Pass the ID of an existing entry.

errors.message: ERR No such user '<username>'
errors.explain: The user name you passed to `CLIENT KILL USER` doesn't exist. User names are case-sensitive, so check them with `ACL USERS`.

errors.message: ERR Node <node_id> not found in cluster
errors.explain: During an atomic slot migration, a node sent an ID that this node doesn't know. Make sure the importing node has joined the cluster and that `CLUSTER NODES` on this node lists it, then import again.

errors.message: ERR Node config epoch is already non-zero
errors.explain: `CLUSTER SET-CONFIG-EPOCH` works only on a fresh node whose config epoch is still 0, and this node already has one. You only need this command while creating a new cluster.

errors.message: ERR Not a listpack encoded object.
ERR Not a quicklist encoded object.
ERR Not an sds encoded string.
ERR not enough slot numbers provided
errors.explain: The count after `SLOTS` in `HOTKEYS START` is larger than the number of slot numbers that follow it. Make the count match the slots you list.

errors.message: ERR not supported for this module key
errors.explain: The key holds a module data type that doesn't support `COPY`. In Redis 8.10 this includes vector sets and the Bloom filter, cuckoo filter, count-min sketch, Top-K, and t-digest types, while JSON and time series keys can be copied.

errors.message: ERR Notification script seems non existing or non executable
errors.explain: You ran `SENTINEL SET` with `notification-script`, but the path doesn't point to a file that the Sentinel process can execute. Check the path, and make the file executable for the user that runs Sentinel.

errors.message: ERR notification-script must not contain control characters
errors.explain: You ran `SENTINEL SET` with a `notification-script` path that contains a control character, such as a newline or a tab. Pass a plain file path.

errors.message: ERR NOVALUES option can only be used in HSCAN
errors.explain: `NOVALUES` returns only the field names of a hash, so it works only with `HSCAN`. Remove it from `SCAN`, `SSCAN`, or `ZSCAN`.

errors.message: ERR Number of fields must be a positive integer
errors.explain: The number after `FIELDS` is 0, negative, or not an integer. Pass the number of field names that follow it, which must be at least 1.

errors.message: ERR number of IDs doesn't match numids
errors.explain: In `XNACK`, the number after `IDS` is larger than the number of IDs that follow it. Make the count equal to the number of IDs you list.

errors.message: ERR Number of IDs must be a positive integer
errors.explain: The number after `IDS` is 0, negative, or not an integer. Pass the number of entry IDs that follow it, which must be at least 1.

errors.message: ERR Number of keys can't be greater than number of args
errors.explain: The numkeys argument of a command such as `EVAL`, `FCALL`, or `SINTERCARD` is larger than the number of arguments that follow it. Set it to the number of key names you pass right after it, and put any other arguments after the keys.

errors.message: ERR Number of keys can't be negative
errors.explain: The numkeys argument of `EVAL`, `EVALSHA`, `FCALL`, or `FCALL_RO` is negative. Pass `0` if the script or function uses no keys, or otherwise the number of key names that follow.

errors.message: ERR numids must be a positive integer
errors.explain: In `XNACK`, the number after `IDS` is 0, negative, or not an integer. Pass the number of IDs that follow it, which must be at least 1.

errors.message: ERR numkeys should be greater than 0
errors.explain: The number of keys you passed is 0, negative, or not an integer. Pass the number of keys that follow it, which must be at least 1.

errors.message: ERR NX and XX, GT or LT options at the same time are not compatible
errors.explain: You combined `NX` with `XX`, `GT`, or `LT` in an expire command. `NX` sets an expiry only when the key has none, so it can't be combined with options that need an existing expiry; `XX` with `GT` or `LT` is allowed.

errors.message: ERR offset is out of range
errors.explain: You passed `SETRANGE` a negative offset. Pass a byte position of 0 or more; positions past the end pad the string with zero bytes.

errors.message: ERR One or more scores can't be converted into double
errors.explain: `SORT` sorts numerically by default, and at least one element, or a value it read through `BY`, isn't a number. Add `ALPHA` to sort the values as strings, or make sure every value is a number.

errors.message: ERR Only HELLO messages are accepted by Sentinel instances.
errors.explain: You ran `PUBLISH` against a Sentinel on a channel other than `__sentinel__:hello`, the only channel that Sentinels use to announce themselves to each other. Publish your own messages to a Redis server, not to Sentinel.

errors.message: ERR Only one of EX, PX, EXAT, PXAT or KEEPTTL arguments can be specified
errors.explain: You ran `HSETEX` with more than one expiration option. Pass only one of `EX`, `PX`, `EXAT`, `PXAT` or `KEEPTTL`.

errors.message: ERR Only one of EX, PX, EXAT, PXAT or PERSIST arguments can be specified
errors.explain: You ran `HGETEX` with more than one expiration option. Pass only one of `EX`, `PX`, `EXAT`, `PXAT` or `PERSIST`, or none to leave the fields' expiration as it is.

errors.message: ERR Only one of FXX or FNX arguments can be specified
errors.explain: You ran `HSETEX` with both `FXX` and `FNX`, or with one of them twice. Use `FXX` to set the fields only if they all exist, or `FNX` to set them only if none of them exist.

errors.message: ERR Only SENTINEL CONFIG GET <param> [<param> <param> ...] / SET <param> <value> [<param> <value> ...] are supported.
errors.explain: You ran `SENTINEL CONFIG` with a subcommand other than `GET` or `SET`, or with too few arguments, such as `SET` with one option and no value. Use `SENTINEL CONFIG GET` with parameter names, or `SENTINEL CONFIG SET` with name and value pairs.

errors.message: ERR OOM in dictTryExpand
ERR OPTIN and OPTOUT are not compatible with BCAST
errors.explain: You combined `BCAST` with `OPTIN` or `OPTOUT` in `CLIENT TRACKING`. Broadcasting mode sends invalidations for every key that matches your prefixes, so opting reads in or out doesn't apply; choose either `BCAST` or one of the opt modes.

errors.message: ERR Out of range database
ERR overlapping import exists for slot range: <start_slot>-<end_slot>
errors.explain: Another import task already covers the slot range in the message. Check it with `CLUSTER MIGRATION STATUS ALL`, then wait for it or cancel it with `CLUSTER MIGRATION CANCEL` before you import the range again.

errors.message: ERR Parameter `numFields` should be greater than 0
errors.explain: The number after `FIELDS` is 0, negative, or not an integer. Pass the number of field names that follow it, from 1 to 2147483647.

errors.message: ERR Please specify at least one argument for this redis lib call script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
errors.example: ERR Please specify at least one argument for this redis lib call script: 0a907e1429221a4d85516cab7fd219a82a9439d8, on @user_script:1.
errors.explain: Your script called `redis.call()`, `redis.pcall()` or `redis.acl_check_cmd()` with no arguments. Pass the command name first, followed by its arguments, for example `redis.call('GET', KEYS[1])`.

errors.message: ERR Please use EVAL instead of EVALSHA for debugging
errors.explain: This connection is in script debugging mode after `SCRIPT DEBUG YES` or `SCRIPT DEBUG SYNC`, and the debugger only works with `EVAL`, which sends the script's source. Run the script with `EVAL`, or turn debugging off with `SCRIPT DEBUG NO`.

errors.message: ERR Please use SETSLOT only with masters.
errors.explain: `CLUSTER SETSLOT` changes slot ownership and must be sent to a primary, and this node is a replica. Send it to the primary instead.

errors.message: ERR Pre-GA function format not supported
errors.explain: The `FUNCTION RESTORE` payload uses the format of a Redis 7.0 release candidate from before general availability (GA), which current versions can't read. Load the libraries from their source code with `FUNCTION LOAD` instead.

errors.message: ERR Prefix '<prefix>' overlaps with an existing prefix '<existing_prefix>'. Prefixes for a single client must not overlap.
errors.explain: In `BCAST` mode, a prefix you passed overlaps a prefix that this connection already tracks, because one starts with the other, such as `user:` and `user:1`. Keep only the shorter one, or turn tracking off and on again with the new prefixes.

errors.message: ERR Prefix '<prefix>' overlaps with another provided prefix '<other_prefix>'. Prefixes for a single client must not overlap.
errors.explain: Two prefixes in the same `CLIENT TRACKING` call overlap, because one starts with the other, such as `user:` and `user:1`. Keep only the shorter one, which already covers the longer.

errors.message: ERR PREFIX option requires BCAST mode to be enabled
errors.explain: You passed `PREFIX` to `CLIENT TRACKING ON` without `BCAST`. Prefixes only work in broadcasting mode, so add `BCAST`, or drop `PREFIX` to track the keys that this connection reads.

errors.message: ERR producer ID must be non-empty
errors.explain: `XIDMPRECORD`, an internal command, got an empty producer ID, the argument after the key. Pass a non-empty string.

errors.message: ERR Protocol error: expected '$', got '<character>'
errors.example: ERR Protocol error: expected '$', got 'X'
errors.explain: Inside a command sent with the Redis serialization protocol (RESP), an argument didn't start with `$`, and the character in the message came instead. Redis closes the connection; this usually means a bug in the client library, or something other than a Redis client writing to the port.

errors.message: ERR Protocol error: invalid bulk length
errors.explain: An argument's length in the Redis serialization protocol (RESP) isn't a valid number, is negative, or is larger than `proto-max-bulk-len`, which is 512 megabytes by default. Redis closes the connection; send smaller values, or raise `proto-max-bulk-len`.

errors.message: ERR Protocol error: invalid multibulk length
errors.explain: The argument count at the start of a command sent with the Redis serialization protocol (RESP) isn't a valid number, or is larger than 2147483647. Redis closes the connection; this usually points to a bug in the client library or a corrupted stream.

errors.message: ERR Protocol error: too big bulk count string
errors.explain: Redis read more than 64 kilobytes while looking for the end of an argument's length line, so the request isn't valid Redis serialization protocol (RESP). Redis closes the connection; check that the client sends well-formed commands.

errors.message: ERR Protocol error: too big inline request
errors.explain: Redis received more than 64 kilobytes of plain text without a newline, so it rejected it as an oversized inline command and closed the connection. Send large values with a Redis client, which uses the Redis serialization protocol (RESP), not as plain text.

errors.message: ERR Protocol error: too big mbulk count string
errors.explain: Redis read more than 64 kilobytes while looking for the end of the line that gives a command's argument count, so the request isn't valid Redis serialization protocol (RESP). Redis closes the connection; check that the client sends well-formed commands.

errors.message: ERR Protocol error: unauthenticated bulk length
errors.explain: This connection hasn't authenticated yet, and it sent an argument longer than 16384 bytes, which Redis refuses before authentication. Redis closes the connection; authenticate with `AUTH` or `HELLO` first, then send large values.

errors.message: ERR Protocol error: unauthenticated multibulk length
errors.explain: This connection hasn't authenticated yet, and it sent a command with more than 10 arguments, which Redis refuses before authentication. Redis closes the connection; authenticate with `AUTH` or `HELLO` first.

errors.message: ERR Protocol error: unbalanced quotes in request
errors.explain: An inline command, sent as plain text such as from `telnet`, has a quote that isn't closed. Redis closes the connection; close the quote, or send the command with a Redis client instead.

errors.message: ERR Protocol version is not an integer or out of range
errors.explain: The protocol version you passed to `HELLO` isn't an integer. Pass `2` or `3`, as in `HELLO 3`.

errors.message: ERR PSUBSCRIBE isn't allowed for a DENY BLOCKING client
errors.explain: `PSUBSCRIBE` came from a connection that must get exactly one reply per command, such as a module calling Redis, so it can't enter Pub/Sub mode. Send `PSUBSCRIBE` from a normal client connection instead.

errors.message: ERR PSYNC FAILOVER can't be sent to a master.
ERR PSYNC FAILOVER replid must match my replid.
ERR Publish message is too large for cluster propagation
errors.explain: In a cluster, Redis forwards each published message to the other nodes, and the forwarded message, including the channel name, must stay under 4 gigabytes. Publish smaller messages, for example by storing the payload in a key and publishing the key name.

errors.message: ERR Quorum must be 1 or greater.
errors.explain: You ran `SENTINEL MONITOR` with a quorum of 0 or less. Pass the number of Sentinels that must agree that the primary is down, which must be at least 1 and is usually a majority of your Sentinels.

errors.message: ERR radius cannot be negative
errors.explain: The radius in `GEORADIUS`, `GEORADIUSBYMEMBER`, or after `BYRADIUS` is negative. Pass a radius of 0 or more, followed by the unit.

errors.message: ERR range exceeds maximum of 1000000 items
errors.explain: You asked `ARGETRANGE` for more than 1,000,000 positions, and it returns every position in the range, empty ones included. Request smaller ranges, or use `ARSCAN`, which returns only the positions that hold values.

errors.message: ERR RANK can't be zero: use 1 to start from the first match, 2 from the second ... or use negative to start from the end of the list
errors.explain: You passed `LPOS` a `RANK` of 0. Use 1 for the first match, 2 for the second and so on, or a negative rank to count matches from the end of the list.

errors.message: ERR reached lua stack limit
errors.explain: Your script returned a value nested so deeply, such as tables inside tables thousands of levels down, that Lua ran out of stack space while Redis turned it into a reply. Return a flatter structure.

errors.message: ERR Reconfiguration of scripts path is denied for security reasons. Check the deny-scripts-reconfig configuration directive in your Sentinel configuration
errors.explain: You ran `SENTINEL SET` with `notification-script` or `client-reconfig-script`, but this Sentinel doesn't let you change script paths at runtime, which is the default. Set the script in the Sentinel configuration file, or set `sentinel deny-scripts-reconfig no` there and restart Sentinel.

errors.message: ERR redis.log() requires two arguments or more. script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
errors.explain: Your script called `redis.log()` with fewer than two arguments. Pass the log level first and then the message, for example `redis.log(redis.LOG_NOTICE, 'done')`.

errors.message: ERR redis.register_function can only be called on FUNCTION LOAD command script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
errors.example: ERR redis.register_function can only be called on FUNCTION LOAD command script: h6, on @user_function:3.
errors.explain: Your function called `redis.register_function` while it ran with `FCALL`, for example through a reference saved while the library loaded. Only the library's top-level code can register functions, during `FUNCTION LOAD`, so remove the call from the function body.

errors.message: ERR redis.set_repl() requires one argument. script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
errors.explain: Your script called `redis.set_repl()` with no argument or with more than one. Pass exactly one flag, such as `redis.REPL_ALL` or `redis.REPL_NONE`.

errors.message: ERR redis.setresp() requires one argument. script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
errors.explain: Your script called `redis.setresp()` with no argument or with more than one. Pass exactly one value, 2 or 3.

errors.message: ERR regular expression backreferences are not supported
errors.explain: An `RE` pattern that you passed to `ARGREP` uses a backreference, such as `\1`, which `ARGREP` doesn't support. Rewrite the pattern without backreferences.

errors.message: ERR regular expression is empty
errors.explain: You passed `ARGREP` an `RE` predicate with an empty pattern. Pass a regular expression of at least one character.

errors.message: ERR regular expression is too long, maximum is 2048 bytes
errors.explain: An `RE` pattern that you passed to `ARGREP` is longer than 2,048 bytes. Use a shorter pattern, or split it into several `RE` predicates, which `ARGREP` combines with `OR` by default.

errors.message: ERR rename-command arguments must not contain control characters
errors.explain: You ran `SENTINEL SET` with `rename-command`, and the old or the new command name contains a control character, such as a newline or a tab. Pass the names exactly as `rename-command` sets them on the Redis server.

errors.message: ERR REPLCONF ip-address provided by replica instance is too long: <length> bytes
ERR Replica can't interact with the keyspace
errors.explain: A connection that registered as a replica with `SYNC` or `PSYNC` then sent a command that reads or writes keys. Replication connections can't access data; open a normal connection for those commands.

errors.message: ERR REPLICAOF not allowed in cluster mode.
errors.explain: `REPLICAOF` and `SLAVEOF` don't work on a cluster node, because the cluster manages replication itself. Use `CLUSTER REPLICATE` with the node ID of the primary instead.

errors.message: ERR REPLICAOF not allowed while failing over.
errors.explain: A failover started with `FAILOVER` is running, and `REPLICAOF` is blocked until it ends. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it with `FAILOVER ABORT`.

errors.message: ERR Requested level <level> differs from master's level: <master_level>
ERR RESP version must be 2 or 3. script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
errors.example: ERR RESP version must be 2 or 3. script: 675b353b51c5124a750a3c0f7a75c6a6ca5e11a1, on @user_script:1.
errors.explain: Your script called `redis.setresp()` with a value other than 2 or 3. Pass 2 or 3 to choose the version of the Redis serialization protocol (RESP) that `redis.call()` uses for replies inside the script.

errors.message: ERR RESP2 is not supported by this command
ERR resulting score is not a number (NaN)
errors.explain: The increment would make the member's score not a number (NaN), which happens when you add `-inf` to a score of `+inf`, or the reverse. Use a finite increment, or set the score again with `ZADD`.

errors.message: ERR Rewriting config file: <reason>
errors.explain: `CONFIG REWRITE` couldn't write the configuration file, for the operating system reason at the end of the message, such as no write permission. Check that the Redis process can write to the file and to its directory.

errors.message: ERR SAMPLE ratio must be positive
errors.explain: The `SAMPLE` ratio in `HOTKEYS START` isn't a positive integer. Pass 1 to track every key, or a larger number N to track each key with a probability of 1 in N.

errors.message: ERR Script attempted to access a non local key in a cluster node script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
errors.explain: Your script called a command on a key whose hash slot another cluster node serves, usually because the script builds key names instead of taking them from `KEYS`. Pass every key name in `KEYS`, so your client sends the script to the right node.

errors.message: ERR Script attempted to access a slot being trimmed script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
errors.explain: Your script tried to write to a key in a hash slot whose keys this node is deleting in the background, for example after `SFLUSH`. Retry after the deletion finishes.

errors.message: ERR Script attempted to access a slot not served script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
errors.explain: Your script accessed a key in a hash slot that no cluster node serves, so the cluster can't handle that key. Check `CLUSTER INFO` and assign the slot to a node, then retry.

errors.message: ERR Script attempted to access keys that do not hash to the same slot script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
errors.explain: Your script accessed keys in different hash slots, and at least one of them wasn't declared in `KEYS`. Declare every key in `KEYS`, and use hash tags, such as `{user1}:name` and `{user1}:email`, to put the keys in one slot.

errors.message: ERR Script attempted to execute a command while the cluster is down script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
errors.explain: Your script ran a command while the cluster is down, for example because some hash slots have no working node. Fix the cluster, which `CLUSTER INFO` reports as `cluster_state:fail`, then retry.

errors.message: ERR Script attempted to execute a write command while the cluster is down and readonly script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
errors.explain: Your script tried to write while the cluster is down. Because `cluster-allow-reads-when-down` is on, reads still work but writes don't; fix the cluster, which `CLUSTER INFO` reports as `cluster_state:fail`, then retry.

errors.message: ERR SCRIPT DEBUG must be called outside a pipeline
errors.explain: You sent `SCRIPT DEBUG` in a pipeline, while replies to earlier commands on the connection were still waiting to be sent. Send it on its own and wait for the reply before you continue; `redis-cli --ldb` does this for you.

errors.message: ERR SCRIPT FLUSH only support SYNC|ASYNC option
errors.explain: You passed `SCRIPT FLUSH` an argument other than `SYNC` or `ASYNC`, or more than one argument. Run `SCRIPT FLUSH SYNC` or `SCRIPT FLUSH ASYNC`, or no option at all to let the `lazyfree-lazy-user-flush` setting choose.

errors.message: ERR Script killed by user with SCRIPT KILL... script: <script>, on <source>:<line>.
